provider_kind: Investor-owned utility, regulated by the Florida Public Service Commission
notes: Serves most of Bay County, including the cities. FPL took over Gulf Power's Northwest Florida customers in 2022. Phone is FPL's outage line (1-800-4-OUTAGE).

Serves parts of Bay County, mostly the north and east: Southport, Fountain and parts of Lynn Haven, plus Tyndall Air Force Base. Co-op and FPL lines can run through the same neighborhood, so your bill is the sure answer.

provider_kind: Natural gas utility, regulated by the Florida Public Service Commission
notes: Natural gas where its lines run, in every Bay County city and parts of the unincorporated county. Many homes have no gas line; propane comes from private dealers. If you smell gas, leave and call 911 or the number here.
No local government sells internet here. The FCC's National Broadband Map lists the companies that report service at each address and their speeds.

Bay County's recycling program closed after Hurricane Michael (2018) and no city runs curbside recycling. The county keeps a list of private recycling outlets. Batteries, paint, oil and other household hazardous waste go free to the Steelfield Road Landfill.
Retail water where the county runs the lines. Parts of the unincorporated county get city water from Panama City or Panama City Beach instead, and many rural homes are on a private well.
Panama City's utility also serves parts of the unincorporated county next to the city.
Where the county has sewer lines. Many unincorporated homes are on a septic tank instead.
Parts of the unincorporated county next to Panama City.

Bay County doesn't collect household garbage outside the cities. You sign up with a licensed hauler, which sets your pickup day. Licensed haulers include Waste Pro (850-872-1800), Waste Management (850-874-1019), K. C. Disposal (850-819-0575), Coastal Waste & Recycling (850-769-4304), BCC Waste Solutions (850-238-3609) and Coqui Disposal (850-257-5939). You can also haul it yourself to the Steelfield Road Landfill or the Bayline Drive drop-off center ($5 minimum).

Take yard debris to the Steelfield Road Landfill ($38.19 a ton, $5 minimum in 2025) or ask your hauler. The landfill waives fees for residential trash, appliances and trees on Waste Amnesty Days each spring and fall.
Start, stop or move service through Utility Billing. New rates start with October 2026 usage.
